    <style>
        :root {
            --color-accent: #F35B0C;
            --color-agent-bg: #EEE;
            --color-user-bg: #DCF8C6;
            --color-placeholder: #999;
            --color-header-bg: linear-gradient(90deg, #315EA8, #702BAA);
            --color-header-bg-hover: #274d90;
            --font-main: "Lota Grotesque", sans-serif;
            --radius-md: 12px;

            --font-xs: 11px;
            --font-sm: 12px;
            --font-md: 14px;
            --font-lg: 16px;
        }

        input.input-error {
            border: 2px solid var(--color-accent) !important;
        }

        .form-error,
        .error-message {
            font-size: var(--font-sm);
            color: var(--color-accent);
            margin-top: 4px;
            font-weight: normal;
            text-align: left;
            width: 100%;
            display: block;
        }

        #chat-open-btn {
            position: fixed;
            bottom: 20px;
            right: 20px;
            z-index: 99999;
            border: none;
            background: none;
            cursor: pointer;
            display: none;
        }

        #chat-open-btn img {
            width: 60px;
            height: 60px;
        }

        #chat-window {
            font-family: var(--font-main), sans-serif;
            width: 400px;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            background: #fff;
            border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
            box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2);
            position: fixed;
            bottom: 50px;
            right: 20px;
            z-index: 10000;
            opacity: 0;
            transform: translateY(20px);
            transition: opacity 0.3s ease, transform 0.3s ease;
            pointer-events: none;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .chat-send-btn {
            position: relative;
            width: 40px;
            height: 40px;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
        }

        .chat-send-btn .spinner {
            width: 18px;
            height: 18px;
            border: 2px solid #ccc;
            border-top: 2px solid var(--color-accent);
            border-radius: 50%;
            animation: spin 0.8s linear infinite;
        }

        .chat-send-btn .icon {
            display: block;
        }

        .chat-send-btn.loading .icon {
            display: none;
        }

        .chat-send-btn.loading .spinner {
            display: block !important;
        }

        .chat-send-btn,
        .chat-image-btn,
        #chat-window button {
            border: none;
            cursor: pointer;
            color: #fff;
        }

        #chat-window button img {
            width: 22px;
            height: 22px;
        }

        #chat-window.active {
            opacity: 1;
            transform: translateY(0);
            pointer-events: all;
        }

        #chat-window.state-chat {
            height: 600px;
        }

        #chat-window.state-prechat,
        #chat-window.state-postchat {
            height: auto;
            min-height: 0;
        }

        #chat-body-wrapper {
            flex: 1;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .chat-header {
            background: var(--color-header-bg);
            color: white;
            border-radius: var(--radius-lg) var(--radius-lg) 0 0;
            padding: var(--font-lg);
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: space-between;
            font-size: var(--font-lg);
            font-weight: bold;
        }

        .chat-header-right {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
        }

        .chat-send-btn,
        .chat-image-btn {
            background: none;
        }

        .chat-send-btn.disabled {
            opacity: 0.5;
            cursor: not-allowed;
        }

        .chat-send-btn.disabled img {
            opacity: 0.5;
            pointer-events: none;
        }

        .chat-panel,
        #prechat-form,

            padding: var(--padding-lg);
            display: none;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 14px;

            border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
            width: 100%;
            box-sizing: border-box;
            flex: 1;
        }

        #prechat-form input:not([type="checkbox"]) {
            padding: 10px 14px;
            font-size: var(--font-md);
            background: #efefef;
            border-radius: var(--radius-md);
            width: 100%;
            font-weight: bold;
            box-sizing: border-box;
            border: none;
            margin: 0;
        }

        #prechat-terms {
            position: static !important;

            width: 16px;
            height: 16px;
            cursor: pointer;
        }

        #prechat-submit {
            background: var(--color-header-bg);
            color: #fff;
            padding: 10px 40px;
            border: none;
            border-radius: var(--radius-md);
            font-size: var(--font-md);
            font-weight: bold;
            cursor: pointer;
        }

        #prechat-submit:hover {
            background: var(--color-header-bg-hover);
        }

        .checkbox-label {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            font-size: 13px;
            font-weight: 500;
        }

        .checkbox-label a {
            color: var(--color-accent);
            font-weight: bold;
            text-decoration: underline;
            margin-left: 6px;
        }

        .checkbox-wrapper {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            align-items: flex-start;
        }
        
        .checkbox-wrapper .error-message {
            text-align: left;
        }

        .prechat-footer {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: flex-start;
            gap: 10px;
            width: 100%;
        }

        #chat-content-container {
            flex: 1;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .chat-body {
            flex: 1;
            overflow-y: auto;
            overflow-x: hidden;
            overscroll-behavior: contain;

            color: #888;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 8px;
        }

        .chat-message {
            padding: 10px 14px;
            border-radius: 14px;
            font-size: var(--font-md);
            line-height: 1.4;
            max-width: 75%;
            word-break: break-word;
            position: relative;
        }

            background-color: var(--color-user-bg);
            align-self: flex-end;
        }

        .chat-message.agent {
            background-color: var(--color-agent-bg);
            align-self: flex-start;
        }

            background-color: transparent;

            font-size: var(--font-sm);

            max-width: 100%;
            margin: 8px 0;

        }

            text-align: right;

    <script>
        document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", _ => {
            const ACTIVATE_BTN_URL = {
                'SEND_CODE': 'send_code',
                'CHECK_CODE': 'check_code'
            };

            const ALLOWED_OPERATOR_CODES = ['50','51','10','55','99','70','77','60'];

            const ALLOWED_PHONE_NUMBER_DIGITS_AMOUNT = 12;

            const ACTION_EXECUTION_DELAY = 300;

            const MODAL_TYPES = {
                'YANDEX': 'yandex'
            }

            const REDIRECT_TO_YANDEX_SERVICES_DELAY = 3000;
            const REDIRECT_YANDEX_SERVICES_URL = 'http://google.com';

            function cleanUpModalUiState(closeBtn) {
                const modal = closeBtn.closest('.modal');
                const form = modal.querySelector('form');
                const activateBtn = modal.querySelector('#btn-activate');

                const codeInput = form.querySelector('[name="code"]');
                const codeInputWrap = codeInput.closest('.form__input-row');

                const phoneInput = form.querySelector('[name="phone"]');
                const phoneInputWrap = phoneInput.closest('.form__input-row');

                const phoneModeInfo = form.querySelector('[data-mode="phone"]');
                const checkCodeModeInfo = form.querySelector('[data-mode="check-code"]');

                const activateBtnDataUrl = activateBtn.getAttribute('data-url');
            
                const isPhoneModeActive = activateBtnDataUrl === ACTIVATE_BTN_URL.SEND_CODE;
                const isCheckCodeModeActive = activateBtnDataUrl === ACTIVATE_BTN_URL.CHECK_CODE;

                if (!isPhoneModeActive && !isCheckCodeModeActive) return;

                if (isCheckCodeModeActive) {
                    codeInputWrap.classList.add('card-hide');
                    phoneInputWrap.classList.remove('card-hide');
                    checkCodeModeInfo.classList.add('card-hide');
                    phoneModeInfo.classList.remove('card-hide');
                    codeInputWrap.classList.remove('error');
                    activateBtn.setAttribute('data-url', ACTIVATE_BTN_URL.SEND_CODE);
                    activateBtn.innerText = 'Kodu ÉldÉ et ';
                    codeInputWrap.querySelector('.error-message').style.display= 'none';
                }

                if (isPhoneModeActive) {
                    phoneInputWrap.classList.remove('error');
                    phoneInputWrap.querySelector('.error-message').style.display= 'none';
                }
                
                activateBtn.classList.remove('disable');
                codeInput.value = '';
                phoneInput.value = '';
                
            }

            function closeGetPackModal (e) {
                MicroModal.close('get-pack');
                cleanUpModalUiState(e.target);
            }

            function setModalTitle (modal) {
                modal.querySelector('#mobile-tariff').innerText=this.getAttribute('data-title');
            }

            function setModalSubtitle (modal) {
                const subtitle = this.getAttribute('data-subtitle');
                if (!subtitle) return;

                modal.querySelector('#subtitle').innerText = subtitle;
            }
            
            function setDataAttrInModal (modal) {
                modal.querySelector('#mobile-tariff').setAttribute('data-activate-price', this.getAttribute('data-price'));
                modal.querySelector('#btn-activate').setAttribute('data-otp', this.getAttribute('data-otp'));

                // !!! qr code logic is not active for now
                const qrCodeEl = modal.querySelector('#qr_code');
                if (!qrCodeEl) return;
                qrCodeEl.setAttribute('src', this.getAttribute('data-qr'));
            }

            function toggleVisibilityQRCode (modal) {
                // !!! qr code logic is not active for now
                let qr = this.getAttribute('data-qr').replace('/az/qr_code_generator?qr_code=', '');
                let src = qr ? this.getAttribute('data-qr') : '/theme/images/common/white.jpg';
                const qrCodeEl = modal.querySelector('#qr_code');
                if (!qrCodeEl) return;
                qrCodeEl.setAttribute('src', src);
                const qrCodeElWrapper = modal.querySelector('#qr-code-wrapper');
                if (!qrCodeElWrapper) return;
                qrCodeElWrapper.style.display = qr === "" ? "none" : "block";
            }

            function setAnotherMethodTabContent(modal) {
                let isFastActivationNumberExist = false;
                let isSmsActivationNumberExist = false;
                let isSmsActivationTextExist = false;
                const fastActivationNumber = this.getAttribute('data-fast-activation-code');
                const fastActivationNumberEl = modal.querySelector('[data-fast-activation-code]');
                if (fastActivationNumber && fastActivationNumberEl) {
                    isFastActivationNumberExist = true;
                    fastActivationNumberEl.innerHTML = fastActivationNumber;
                }

                const smsActivationNumber = this.getAttribute('data-sms-activation-number');
                const smsActivationNumberEl = modal.querySelector('[data-sms-activation-number]');
                if (smsActivationNumber && smsActivationNumberEl) {
                    isSmsActivationNumberExist = true;
                    smsActivationNumberEl.innerHTML = smsActivationNumber;
                }
                
                const smsActivationText = this.getAttribute('data-sms-activation-text');
                const smsActivationTextEl = modal.querySelector('[data-sms-activation-text]');
                if (smsActivationText && smsActivationTextEl) {
                    isSmsActivationTextExist = true;
                    smsActivationTextEl.innerHTML = smsActivationText;
                }

                if (!isFastActivationNumberExist && !(isSmsActivationNumberExist && isSmsActivationTextExist))
                    modal.querySelector('#tab-titles').style.display = 'none';
            }

            // get the code and send received verification code to activate pack
            function addActivateBtnEventListener (e) {

                function displayPhoneErrorMessage(isFullPhone, isAllowedOperatorCode) {
                    setTimeout(()=> {
                        phoneInputWrap.classList.add('error');
                        phoneInputWrap.querySelector('.error-message').style.display = 'block';
                        activateBtn.classList.remove('disabled');
                        // currently one message covers all validation cases
                        // if(!isAllowedOperatorCode) {
                        //     phoneInputWrap.querySelector('.error-message').style.display= 'none';
                        //     phoneInputWrap.querySelector('.alerts-info').style.display = 'flex';
                        // }
                    }, ACTION_EXECUTION_DELAY);
                }

                function hidePhoneErrorMessage() {
                    setTimeout(()=> {
                        phoneInputWrap.classList.remove('error');
                        phoneInputWrap.querySelector('.error-message').style.display= 'none';
                        // currently one message covers all validation cases
                        // phoneInputWrap.querySelector('.alerts-info').style.display = 'none';
                    }, ACTION_EXECUTION_DELAY);
                }

                function validatePhoneNumber() {
                    let isValid = true;
                    phone = phone.match(/\d/g);
                    let operatorCode = phone.slice(3, 5).join('');

                    const isFullPhone = phone && phone.length === ALLOWED_PHONE_NUMBER_DIGITS_AMOUNT;
                    const isAllowedOperatorCode = ALLOWED_OPERATOR_CODES.includes(operatorCode);

                    if(!isFullPhone || !isAllowedOperatorCode) {
                        displayPhoneErrorMessage(isFullPhone, isAllowedOperatorCode);
                        isValid = false;
                    }

                    return isValid;
                }

                function activateCheckCodeMode() {
                    phoneInputWrap.classList.add('card-hide');
                    codeInputWrap.classList.remove('card-hide');
                    checkCodeModeInfo.classList.remove('card-hide');
                    phoneModeInfo.classList.add('card-hide');

                    activateBtn.setAttribute('data-url', ACTIVATE_BTN_URL.CHECK_CODE);

                    activateBtn.innerText = 'Submit';
                    codeInput.addEventListener('focus', _ => codeInputWrap.classList.remove('error'));
                    form.querySelector('.resend-code').addEventListener('click', (e) => {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        fetchVerificationCode();
                    });
                }

                function fetchVerificationCode() {
                    return new Promise((resolve, reject)=> {
                        const strOtp = activateBtn.getAttribute('data-otp');
                        const phoneValue = phone.join("");
                        activateBtn.setAttribute('data-phone', phoneValue);
                        try {
                            grecaptcha.ready(function() {
                                grecaptcha.execute("6Lc0R-wjAAAAAJ_r2DEsw89xb-d04dAgKszT2_im", {action: 'submit'})
                                  .then(function(token) {
                                      return fetch(`/az/${ACTIVATE_BTN_URL.SEND_CODE}?phone=${phoneValue}&str_otp=${strOtp}&t=${Date.now()}`
                                        ,
                                        {
                                            headers: {
                                                'Content-Type': 'text/plain',
                                                'X-R-Token': token,
                                            }
                                        }
                                      )

        console.log('adding listeners', document.querySelectorAll('.form_btn'));
        document.querySelectorAll('.form_btn').forEach(item => {
            item.addEventListener('click', function (e) {

                let id = form.getAttribute('data-url');

                if(id==='sustainability_form' || id==='contest_form' || id==='contact_us_image_form') {
                    grecaptcha.ready(function() {
                        grecaptcha.execute("6Lc0R-wjAAAAAJ_r2DEsw89xb-d04dAgKszT2_im", {action: 'submit'})
                            .then(function(token) {
                                var input = document.createElement("input");
                                input.type = "hidden";
                                input.name = "g-recaptcha";
                                input.value = token;
                                form.appendChild(input);

                                sendRequest(form, id, formWrap);
                            });
                    });
                } else {
                    sendRequest(form, id, formWrap);
                }

                this.classList.remove('disabled');
            });
        });
    }

    function sendRequest(form, id, formWrap) {
        fetch('/az/' + id, {
            method: 'post',
            body: new FormData(form)
        })
            .then(res => res.json())

                if (res.errors) {
                    formWrap.innerHTML = res.output;

                        let elBlock = formWrap.querySelector(`[name='${key}']`);

                            elBlock = formWrap.querySelector(`[name='${key}[]']`);
                        }
                        if (elBlock) {
                            let inputBlock = elBlock.closest('.form__input-row');
                            inputBlock.classList.add('error');
                            if(inputBlock.classList.contains('custom-select__trigger')){
                                inputBlock.parentElement.querySelector('.error-message').innerHTML = res.errors[key];
                            }else{
                                inputBlock.querySelector('.error-message').innerHTML = res.errors[key];
                            };
                        }
                    });
                    sendForm();
                    initPhoneMask();
                    if (typeof imageUpload === 'function') {
                        const formType = form.querySelector('.form_type_id').value;
                        if (dt[formType]) {
                            dt[formType].clearData();
                        }

                        mailchimpData.append('u', 'bc9a6b6aca9c0e60bf0509903');
                        mailchimpData.append('id', '768b7f520d');
                        fetch(mailchimpUrl, {
                            method: 'post',
                            body: mailchimpData
                        });
                    }
                    let modalForm = form.closest('.micromodal-slide');
                    if (res.code) {
                        formWrap.innerHTML = res.output;
                        sendForm();

                        MicroModal.close(modalForm.getAttribute('id'));
                        MicroModal.show(id);
                    } else {

                            const formType = form.querySelector('.form_type_id').value;

        const ImageHandler = {
            async handleUpload(file) {

        const UploadHandlerQueue = [];

        const RatingHandler = {
            currentRating: -1,

            init() {
                DOM.stars.forEach((star, index) => {
                    star.addEventListener('mouseenter', () => this.highlight(index));

                    star.classList.toggle('selected', i <= uptoIndex);

            set(index) {

                this.highlight(index);

                    console.error("â Failed to send rating:", err);

        const GenesysEvents = {
            subscribeToAll() {
                Genesys("subscribe", "Messenger.ready", () => {
                    DOM.chatBtn.style.display = 'block';
                });

                Genesys('subscribe', 'MessagingService.ready', () => {});

                Genesys("subscribe", "MessagingService.messagesReceived", e => {
                    const messages = e?.data?.messages || [];
                    messages.forEach(msg => {
                        if (msg && msg.type === "Event") {
                            const event = msg.events?.[0];
                            if (event?.presence?.type === "Disconnect") {
                                // showPostChatForm(); // Don't show post-chat form immediately on disconnect
                                addMessageToChat(TRANSLATION.chat_ended, "system");
                                return;
                            }
                        }

                        const type = msg.direction === "Inbound" ? "user" : "agent";
                        let text = msg?.text || msg?.message || "";
                        text = filterSystemMessage(text);
                        
                        if (text) {
                            DOM.placeholder.style.display = 'none';
                            DOM.typingIndicator.style.display = 'none';
                            addMessageToChat(`${text}<time>${getTime()}</time>`, type, true);
                        }

                        const contentArray = msg?.content || [];
                        contentArray.forEach(c => {
                            const attachment = c?.attachment;
                            if (attachment?.mime?.startsWith("image/") && attachment?.url) {
                                const imageHTML = `<img src="${attachment.url}" class="chat-image" /><time>${getTime()}</time>`;
                                addMessageToChat(imageHTML, type, true);
                            }
                        });
                    });
                });

                Genesys("subscribe", "Conversation.historyLoaded", e => {
                    const messages = e?.data?.messages || [];
                    messages.forEach(msg => {
                        const type = msg.direction === "Inbound" ? "user" : "agent";
                        let text = msg?.text || msg?.message || "";
                        text = filterSystemMessage(text);

                        if (text) addMessageToChat(`${text}<time>${getTime()}</time>`, type, true);
                    });
                });

                // Genesys("subscribe", "MessagingService.typingreceived", () => {
                //    DOM.typingIndicator.style.display = 'block';

                Genesys("subscribe", "MessagingService.typingtimeout", () => {
                    DOM.typingIndicator.style.display = 'none';
                });

                Genesys("subscribe", "MessagingService.fileUploaded", (event) => {
                    const handler = UploadHandlerQueue.shift();
                    if (handler && event?.data?.attachmentId) {
                        handler.resolve(event.data.attachmentId);
                    }
                });
            }
        };

        function getTime() {
            const now = new Date();
            return now.toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' });
        }

        function showError(inputId, message) {
            const input = document.getElementById(inputId);
            const errorSpan = document.getElementById('error-' + inputId.split('-')[1]);
            if (!input || !errorSpan) return;
            input.classList.add('input-error');

            ChatStorage.saveHistory(DOM.chatBody.innerHTML);

            const saved = ChatStorage.loadHistory()

                DOM.chatBody.innerHTML = saved;
                updateImageGallery();
                attachImageClickEvents();

            DOM.typingIndicator.style.display = 'none';

        function filterSystemMessage(text) {
            if (!text || typeof text !== 'string') return text;
            if (text.includes(" :: ")) {
                const parts = text.split(" :: ");
                const lang = 'az';
                let index = 0; // Default to AZ
                if (lang === 'ru') index = 1;
                if (lang === 'en') index = 2;
                
                return parts[index] || parts[0] || text;
            }
            return text;
        }

        function validatePrechatForm() {

            clearErrors();
            let hasError = false;

            const name = nameInput.value.trim();
            const prefix = prefixSelect.value;
            const phoneBody = phoneBodyInput.value.replace(/\D/g, ''); // Strip non-digits
            const termsAccepted = termsCheckbox.checked;

            if (!name) {
                showError("prechat-name", TRANSLATION.val_name);
                hasError = true;
            }

            // Expecting exactly 7 digits
            if (phoneBody.length !== 7) {
                showError("prechat-phone", TRANSLATION.val_phone);
                hasError = true;
            }

            if (!termsAccepted) {
                showError("prechat-terms", TRANSLATION.val_terms);
                hasError = true;
            }

            return !hasError;
        }

       // Scroll Lock
        function addScrollLock() {
            const container = document.getElementById('chat-window');
            if(!container) return;

            container.addEventListener('wheel', function (e) {
                let target = e.target;
                let scrollable = null;

                // Find the nearest scrollable ancestor within the container
                while (target && target !== container) {
                    if (target.scrollHeight > target.clientHeight) {
                        const style = window.getComputedStyle(target);
                        if (['auto', 'scroll'].includes(style.overflowY)) {
                            scrollable = target;
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                    target = target.parentElement;
                }

                // If no scrollable area found, block scroll
                if (!scrollable) {
                    if (e.cancelable) e.preventDefault();
                    return;
                }

                // If scrollable, check edges
                const atTop = scrollable.scrollTop <= 0;
                const atBottom = Math.abs(scrollable.scrollHeight - scrollable.scrollTop - scrollable.clientHeight) < 1;

                if ((e.deltaY < 0 && atTop) || (e.deltaY > 0 && atBottom)) {
                    if (e.cancelable) e.preventDefault();
                }
            }, { passive: false });
        }

                     DOM.placeholder = placeholder; // Update ref

                     ChatState.imageGallery = [];
                     
                     // Send 'clear' command to Genesys if supported or just local clear
                     Genesys("command", "MessagingService.clearConversation");

                     DOM.deletePopup.style.display = 'none';
                     
                     // Smoothly close the chat
                     closeChat();
                });
            }

            if (DOM.deleteNoBtn) {
                 DOM.deleteNoBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
                     DOM.deletePopup.style.display = 'none';
                 });
            }


            DOM.prechatSubmit.onclick = async () => {
                if (!validatePrechatForm()) return;

                const name = document.getElementById('prechat-name').value.trim();
                const prefix = document.getElementById('prechat-prefix').value;
                const phoneBodyRaw = document.getElementById('prechat-phone-body').value.replace(/\D/g, '');
                
                // Combine prefix and body for CustomerID and Genesys
                const fullPhone = `994${prefix}${phoneBodyRaw}`;
                const clientData = { name, phone: fullPhone };

                await syncClientDataWithGenesys(clientData);
                showChatBody();
            };


            DOM.sendBtn.onclick = async () => {
                const text = DOM.input.value.trim();
                const pending = ChatState.pendingImage;

                if (!text && !pending) return;

                if (text) {
                    await new Promise(resolve => {
                        Genesys("command", "MessagingService.sendMessage", { message: text }, resolve, resolve);
                    });
                }

                if (pending?.file) {
                    disableSendButton();

                    const uploadId = await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
                        UploadHandlerQueue.push({ resolve, reject });

                        Genesys("command", "MessagingService.requestUpload", { file: [pending.file] },
                            () => {},
                            err => {
                                UploadHandlerQueue.pop();
                                reject(err);
                            }
                        );

                        setTimeout(() => {
                            const index = UploadHandlerQueue.findIndex(h => h.resolve === resolve);
                            if (index !== -1) {
                                UploadHandlerQueue.splice(index, 1);
                                reject("Upload timeout");
                            }
                        }, 15000);
                    });


                    await new Promise(resolve => {
                        Genesys("command", "MessagingService.sendMessage", {
                            uploads: [uploadId]
                        }, () => setTimeout(resolve, 300), () => setTimeout(resolve, 300));
                    });

                    enableSendButton();
                }

                DOM.input.value = "";
                if(DOM.placeholder) DOM.placeholder.style.display = 'none';
                DOM.imagePreviewContainer.innerHTML = "";
                ChatState.pendingImage = null;
                DOM.imageInput.value = "";
            };

            DOM.imageBtn.onclick = () => {
                DOM.imageInput.value = "";
                DOM.imageInput.click();
            };

            DOM.imageInput.addEventListener('change', async (event) => {
                const files = event.target.files;
                if (!files.length) return;

                const file = files[0];
                if (!file) return;

                await ImageHandler.handleUpload(file);
            });

            DOM.input.addEventListener("keydown", function (e) {
                if (e.key === "Enter" && !e.shiftKey) {
                    e.preventDefault();
                    DOM.sendBtn.click();
                }

                triggerTypingIndicator();
            });

            DOM.input.addEventListener('paste', () => {
                setTimeout(triggerTypingIndicator, 0);
            });

            // Phone Input Masking
            if (DOM.phoneInput) {
                DOM.phoneInput.addEventListener('input', function (e) {
                    let value = e.target.value.replace(/\D/g, '');
                    if (value.length > 7) value = value.substring(0, 7);

                    if (value.length > 5) {
                        value = value.substring(0, 3) + '-' + value.substring(3, 5) + '-' + value.substring(5);
                    } else if (value.length > 3) {
                        value = value.substring(0, 3) + '-' + value.substring(3);
                    }
                    e.target.value = value;
                });
            }

            DOM.closeBtn.onclick = closeChat;
            DOM.backBtn.onclick = closeChat;
        }

        function updateImageGallery() {
            ChatState.imageGallery = [...DOM.chatBody.querySelectorAll('.chat-image')].map(img => img.src);
        }

        function attachImageClickEvents() {
            DOM.chatBody.querySelectorAll('.chat-image').forEach((img, index) => {
                img.onclick = () => {
                    ChatState.currentImageIndex = index;
                    ModalHandler.showImage(index);
                };
            });
        }

        function disableSendButton() {
            DOM.sendBtn.classList.add('disabled', 'loading');
            DOM.sendBtn.disabled = true;
        }

        function enableSendButton() {
            DOM.sendBtn.classList.remove('disabled', 'loading');
            DOM.sendBtn.disabled = false;
        }

        function triggerTypingIndicator() {
            if (!DOM.chatWindow.classList.contains('state-chat')) return;
            if (typeof Genesys !== 'function') return;

            const now = Date.now();
            if (now - ChatState.lastTypingTime <= 2000) return;
            ChatState.lastTypingTime = now;

            Genesys("command", "MessagingService.sendTyping", {},
                () => {},
                (err) => console.error("â Typing indicator failed", err)
            );
        }

        function initConversation({ onPrechat, onPostchat, onChat, onError } = {}) {
            const parsed = ChatStorage.loadClientData();
            const hasClientData = !!(parsed?.name && parsed?.phone);
            const openKnownCustomerChat = () => {
                syncClientDataWithGenesys(parsed).finally(() => {
                    onChat?.();
                });
            }

            Genesys("command", "MessagingService.configureConversation", {}, (res) => {
                if (!hasClientData) {
                    onPrechat?.();
                } else {
                    openKnownCustomerChat();
                }
            }, (err) => {
                if (err === 'There is already an active conversation.' && hasClientData) {
                    openKnownCustomerChat();
                } else {
                    onError?.(err);
                    onPrechat?.();
                }
            });
        }

        function openChat() {
            initConversation({
                onPrechat: showPreChatForm,
                onPostchat: showPostChatForm,
                onChat: showChatBody
            });
        }

        function closeChat() {
            DOM.chatWindow.classList.remove('active');
            setTimeout(() => {
                DOM.chatBtn.style.display = 'flex';
            }, 300);
        }

        function showPreChatForm() {
            DOM.chatWindow.classList.add('active', 'state-prechat');
            DOM.chatWindow.classList.remove('state-chat', 'state-postchat');
            DOM.prechatForm.style.display = 'flex';
            DOM.chatBodyWrapper.style.display = 'none';
            DOM.postchatForm.style.display = 'none';
        }

        function showChatBody() {
            DOM.chatWindow.classList.add('active', 'state-chat');
            DOM.chatWindow.classList.remove('state-prechat', 'state-postchat');
            DOM.prechatForm.style.display = 'none';
            DOM.chatBodyWrapper.style.display = 'flex';
            DOM.postchatForm.style.display = 'none';
            ChatState.lastTypingTime = 0;

            requestAnimationFrame(() => scrollToBottom());
        }

        function showPostChatForm() {
            DOM.chatWindow.classList.add('active', 'state-postchat');
            DOM.chatWindow.classList.remove('state-prechat', 'state-chat');
            DOM.prechatForm.style.display = 'none';
            DOM.chatBodyWrapper.style.display = 'none';
            DOM.postchatForm.style.display = 'flex';

            ChatStorage.clear();
        }

        function init() {
            ModalHandler.init();
            RatingHandler.init();
            restoreChatHistory();
            addListeners();
            addScrollLock();
            GenesysEvents.subscribeToAll();
        }

        document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", init);
    </script>
</body>
</html>

    <style>
        :root {
            --color-accent: #F35B0C;
            --color-agent-bg: #EEE;
            --color-user-bg: #DCF8C6;
            --color-placeholder: #999;
            --color-header-bg: linear-gradient(90deg, #315EA8, #702BAA);
            --color-header-bg-hover: #274d90;
            --font-main: "Lota Grotesque", sans-serif;
            --radius-md: 12px;
            --radius-lg: 20px;
            --padding-md: 16px;
            --padding-lg: 24px;
            --font-xs: 11px;
            --font-sm: 12px;
            --font-md: 14px;
            --font-lg: 16px;
        }

        input.input-error {
            border: 2px solid var(--color-accent) !important;
        }

        .form-error,
        .error-message {
            font-size: var(--font-sm);
            color: var(--color-accent);
            margin-top: 4px;
            font-weight: normal;
            text-align: left;
            width: 100%;
            display: block;
        }

        #chat-open-btn {
            position: fixed;
            bottom: 20px;
            right: 20px;
            z-index: 99999;
            border: none;
            background: none;
            cursor: pointer;
            display: none;
        }

        #chat-open-btn img {
            width: 60px;
            height: 60px;
        }

        #chat-window {
            font-family: var(--font-main), sans-serif;
            width: 400px;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            background: #fff;
            border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
            box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2);
            position: fixed;
            bottom: 50px;
            right: 20px;
            z-index: 10000;
            opacity: 0;
            transform: translateY(20px);
            transition: opacity 0.3s ease, transform 0.3s ease;
            pointer-events: none;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .chat-send-btn {
            position: relative;
            width: 40px;
            height: 40px;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
        }

        .chat-send-btn .spinner {
            width: 18px;
            height: 18px;
            border: 2px solid #ccc;
            border-top: 2px solid var(--color-accent);
            border-radius: 50%;
            animation: spin 0.8s linear infinite;
        }

        .chat-send-btn .icon {
            display: block;
        }

        .chat-send-btn.loading .icon {
            display: none;
        }

        .chat-send-btn.loading .spinner {
            display: block !important;
        }

        .chat-send-btn,
        .chat-image-btn,
        #chat-window button {
            border: none;
            cursor: pointer;
            color: #fff;
        }

        #chat-window button img {
            width: 22px;
            height: 22px;
        }

        #chat-window.active {
            opacity: 1;
            transform: translateY(0);
            pointer-events: all;
        }

        #chat-window.state-chat {
            height: 600px;
        }

        #chat-window.state-prechat,
        #chat-window.state-postchat {
            height: auto;
            min-height: 0;
        }

        #chat-body-wrapper {
            flex: 1;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .chat-header {
            background: var(--color-header-bg);
            color: white;
            border-radius: var(--radius-lg) var(--radius-lg) 0 0;
            padding: var(--font-lg);
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: space-between;
            font-size: var(--font-lg);
            font-weight: bold;
        }

        .chat-header-right {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
        }

        .chat-send-btn,
        .chat-image-btn {
            background: none;
        }

        .chat-send-btn.disabled {
            opacity: 0.5;
            cursor: not-allowed;
        }

        .chat-send-btn.disabled img {
            opacity: 0.5;
            pointer-events: none;
        }

        .chat-panel,
        #prechat-form,
        #postchat-form {
            padding: var(--padding-lg);
            display: none;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 14px;
            background: white;
            border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
            width: 100%;
            box-sizing: border-box;
            flex: 1;
        }

        #prechat-form input:not([type="checkbox"]) {
            padding: 10px 14px;
            font-size: var(--font-md);
            background: #efefef;
            border-radius: var(--radius-md);
            width: 100%;
            font-weight: bold;
            box-sizing: border-box;
            border: none;
            margin: 0;
        }

        #prechat-terms {
            position: static !important;
            opacity: 1 !important;
            z-index: auto !important;
            accent-color: var(--color-accent);
            width: 16px;
            height: 16px;
            cursor: pointer;
        }

        #prechat-submit {
            background: var(--color-header-bg);
            color: #fff;

            registration.addEventListener('updatefound', () => {

                    self.skipWaiting();
                }
            });
        });

<script type="text/javascript">
    const dt = {
        'instagram': new DataTransfer(),
        'facebook': new DataTransfer(),
    };

    function sendForm() {
        console.log('adding listeners', document.querySelectorAll('.form_btn'));
        document.querySelectorAll('.form_btn').forEach(item => {
            item.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
                this.classList.add('disabled');
                let form = this.closest('form');
                let formWrap = form.parentElement;
                let id = form.getAttribute('data-url');

                if(id==='sustainability_form' || id==='contest_form' || id==='contact_us_image_form') {
                    grecaptcha.ready(function() {
                        grecaptcha.execute("6Lc0R-wjAAAAAJ_r2DEsw89xb-d04dAgKszT2_im", {action: 'submit'})
                            .then(function(token) {
                                var input = document.createElement("input");
                                input.type = "hidden";
                                input.name = "g-recaptcha";
                                input.value = token;
                                form.appendChild(input);

                                sendRequest(form, id, formWrap);
                            });
                    });
                } else {
                    sendRequest(form, id, formWrap);
                }

                this.classList.remove('disabled');
            });
        });
    }

    function sendRequest(form, id, formWrap) {
        fetch('/az/' + id, {
            method: 'post',
            body: new FormData(form)
        })
            .then(res => res.json())
            .then(res => {
                if (res.errors) {
                    formWrap.innerHTML = res.output;
                    Object.keys(res.errors).forEach((key) => {
                        let elBlock = formWrap.querySelector(`[name='${key}']`);
                        if (!elBlock) {
                            elBlock = formWrap.querySelector(`[name='${key}[]']`);
                        }
                        if (elBlock) {
                            let inputBlock = elBlock.closest('.form__input-row');
                            inputBlock.classList.add('error');
                            if(inputBlock.classList.contains('custom-select__trigger')){
                                inputBlock.parentElement.querySelector('.error-message').innerHTML = res.errors[key];
                            }else{
                                inputBlock.querySelector('.error-message').innerHTML = res.errors[key];
                            };
                        }
                    });
                    sendForm();
                    initPhoneMask();
                    if (typeof imageUpload === 'function') {
                        const formType = form.querySelector('.form_type_id').value;
                        if (dt[formType]) {
                            dt[formType].clearData();
                        }
                        imageUpload();
                    }
                    if (formWrap.querySelector('.custom-select')) {
                        customJsSelect();
                    }
                } else {
                    if(id==='subscription_form'){
                        let mailchimpUrl = 'https://azercell.us7.list-manage.com/subscribe/post';
                        let mailchimpData = new FormData();
                        let email = form.querySelector('[name="email"]').value;
                        mailchimpData.append('MERGE0', email);
                        mailchimpData.append('u', 'bc9a6b6aca9c0e60bf0509903');
                        mailchimpData.append('id', '768b7f520d');
                        fetch(mailchimpUrl, {
                            method: 'post',
                            body: mailchimpData
                        });
                    }
                    let modalForm = form.closest('.micromodal-slide');
                    if (res.code) {
                        formWrap.innerHTML = res.output;
                        sendForm();
                    } else if (modalForm) {
                        MicroModal.close(modalForm.getAttribute('id'));
                        MicroModal.show(id);
                    } else {
                        if (id === 'contest_form') {
                            const formType = form.querySelector('.form_type_id').value;
                            MicroModal.show(id+'_'+formType);

                            if (dt[formType]) {
                                dt[formType].clearData();
                            }
                            let imageUploadEl = document.querySelector('.form_type_'+formType+' .upload__img-wrap');
                            if (imageUploadEl) {
                                imageUploadEl.innerHTML = '';
                            }

                            formEl = document.querySelector('form.contest_form__block.form_type_'+formType);
                            formEl.reset();
                            let labelError = formEl.querySelectorAll('.error');
                            if(labelError.length){
                                labelError.forEach(el=>el.classList.remove('error'));
                            }
                        } else {
                            MicroModal.show(id);
                        }

                        if (id === 'contact_us_image_form') {
                            let contactUsImageForm = document.querySelector('#contactUsImage form');

                            contactUsImageForm.reset();
                            let labelError = contactUsImageForm.querySelectorAll('.error');
                            if(labelError.length){
                                labelError.forEach(el=>el.classList.remove('error'));
                            }
                        }
                    }

                }
            })
    }

    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
        sendForm();
    });
</script>
