        const TRANSLATION = {"title":"Onlayn d\u0259st\u0259k","name_placeholder":"Ad v\u0259 Soyad*","start":"Ba\u015fla","terms":"\u015e\u0259rtl\u0259rl\u0259 tan\u0131\u015f ol","terms_url":"\/assets\/files\/chat\/Privacy%20notice%20for%20web%20-%20AZ%20.docx","welcome_message":"Bu, biziml\u0259 s\u00f6hb\u0259tinizin ba\u015flan\u011f\u0131c\u0131d\u0131r.\u003Cbr \/\u003EBa\u015flamaq \u00fc\u00e7\u00fcn mesaj g\u00f6nd\u0259rin.","typing":"Operator yaz\u0131r...","input_placeholder":"Mesaj g\u00f6nd\u0259r","rate_title":"Xidm\u0259timizi z\u0259hm\u0259t olmasa qiym\u0259tl\u0259ndirin","thank_you":"T\u0259\u015f\u0259kk\u00fcrl\u0259r!","delete_confirm":"\u00c7at tarix\u00e7\u0259sini silm\u0259k ist\u0259diyiniz\u0259 \u0259minsiniz?","yes":"B\u0259li","no":"Xeyr","val_name":"Z\u0259hm\u0259t olmasa ad\u0131n\u0131z\u0131 daxil edin.","val_phone":"Z\u0259hm\u0259t olmasa d\u00fczg\u00fcn mobil n\u00f6mr\u0259 daxil edin.","val_terms":"Z\u0259hm\u0259t olmasa \u015f\u0259rtl\u0259rl\u0259 tan\u0131\u015f olun.","chat_ended":"S\u00f6hb\u0259t operator t\u0259r\u0259find\u0259n bitirildi"};

        const DOM = {
            chatBtn: document.getElementById('chat-open-btn'),
            chatWindow: document.getElementById('chat-window'),
            chatBodyWrapper: document.getElementById('chat-body-wrapper'),
            deleteBtn: document.getElementById('chat-delete-btn'),
            deletePopup: document.getElementById('chat-confirm-popup'),
            deleteYesBtn: document.getElementById('chat-confirm-yes'),
            deleteNoBtn: document.getElementById('chat-confirm-no'),
            closeBtn: document.getElementById('chat-close-btn'),
            backBtn: document.getElementById('chat-back-btn'),
            sendBtn: document.getElementById('chat-send-btn'),
            imageBtn: document.getElementById('chat-image-btn'),
            imageInput: document.getElementById('chat-image-input'),
            modal: document.getElementById('image-modal'),
            modalImg: document.getElementById('modal-img'),
            input: document.getElementById('chat-input'),
            placeholder: document.getElementById('chat-placeholder'),
            chatBody: document.getElementById('chat-body'),
            typingIndicator: document.getElementById('typing-indicator'),
            imagePreviewContainer: document.getElementById('image-preview-container'),
            chatHeader: document.querySelector('.chat-header'),
            prechatForm: document.getElementById('prechat-form'),
            phoneInput: document.getElementById('prechat-phone-body'),
            postchatForm: document.getElementById('postchat-form'),
            prechatSubmit: document.getElementById('prechat-submit'),
            stars: document.querySelectorAll('#postchat-stars .star')
        };

        const ChatState = {
            clientDataProvided: false,
            imageGallery: [],
            pendingImage: {
                file: null,
                previewUrl: null
            },
            currentImageIndex: 0,
            lastTypingTime: 0,
        };

        const ChatStorage = {
            HISTORY_KEY: 'chat-history',
            CLIENT_DATA_KEY: 'clientData',

            saveHistory(html) {
                try {
                    localStorage.setItem(this.HISTORY_KEY, html);
                } catch (e) {
                    console.warn("â ï¸ Could not save chat history:", e);
                }
            },

            loadHistory() {
                try {
                    return localStorage.getItem(this.HISTORY_KEY) || "";
                } catch (e) {
                    console.warn("â ï¸ Could not load chat history:", e);
                    return "";
                }
            },

            saveClientData(data) {
                try {
                    localStorage.setItem(this.CLIENT_DATA_KEY, JSON.stringify(data));
                } catch (e) {
                    console.warn("â ï¸ Could not save client data:", e);
                }
            },

            loadClientData() {
                try {
                    const raw = localStorage.getItem(this.CLIENT_DATA_KEY);
                    return raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : null;
                } catch (e) {
                    console.warn("â ï¸ Could not parse client data:", e);
                    return null;
                }
            },

            clear() {
                try {
                    localStorage.removeItem(this.HISTORY_KEY);
                } catch (e) {
                    console.warn("â ï¸ Could not clear chat history:", e);
                }
            }
        }

        function runGenesysCommand(command, payload = {}) {
            return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
                Genesys("command", command, payload, resolve, reject);
            });
        }

        function buildClientPayload(clientData) {
            const language = 'az';

            return {
                database: {
                    messaging: {
                        customAttributes: {
                            name: clientData.phone,
                            phone: clientData.name,
                            email: "",
                            language
                        }
                    }
                }
            };
        }

        async function syncClientDataWithGenesys(clientData) {
            if (!clientData?.name || !clientData?.phone) return false;

            const payload = buildClientPayload(clientData);

            try {
                await runGenesysCommand("Database.set", payload.database);
                ChatStorage.saveClientData(clientData);
                ChatState.clientDataProvided = true;
                return true;
            } catch (err) {
                console.error("â Database.set failed", err);
                return false;
            }
        }

        const ModalHandler = {
            init() {
                DOM.chatBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
                    DOM.chatBtn.style.display = 'none';
                    openChat();
                });


                this.modal = DOM.modal;
                this.img = DOM.modalImg;
                this.prevBtn = DOM.modal.querySelector('.modal-nav.left');
                this.nextBtn = DOM.modal.querySelector('.modal-nav.right');

                this.prevBtn.onclick = e => {
                    e.stopPropagation();
                    this.showImage(ChatState.currentImageIndex - 1);
                };

                this.nextBtn.onclick = e => {
                    e.stopPropagation();
                    this.showImage(ChatState.currentImageIndex + 1);
                };

                this.modal.addEventListener('click', e => {
                    if (e.target === this.modal) this.close();
                });

                document.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
                    if (this.modal.style.display !== 'flex') return;
                    if (e.key === 'Escape') this.close();
                    if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft') this.showImage(ChatState.currentImageIndex - 1);
                    if (e.key === 'ArrowRight') this.showImage(ChatState.currentImageIndex + 1);
                });
            },

            showImage(index) {
                if (ChatState.imageGallery.length === 0) return;

                ChatState.currentImageIndex = (index + ChatState.imageGallery.length) % ChatState.imageGallery.length;

                this.img.src = ChatState.imageGallery[ChatState.currentImageIndex];
                this.modal.style.display = 'flex';

                this.prevBtn.style.display = ChatState.imageGallery.length > 1 ? 'block' : 'none';
                this.nextBtn.style.display = ChatState.imageGallery.length > 1 ? 'block' : 'none';
            },

            close() {
                this.modal.style.display = 'none';
            }
        };

        const ImageHandler = {
            async handleUpload(file) {
                const reader = new FileReader();
                reader.onload = () => {
                    const wrapper = document.createElement('div');
                    wrapper.className = 'chat-image-preview-wrapper';

                    const img = document.createElement('img');
                    img.src = reader.result;
                    img.className = 'chat-image-preview';

                    img.onclick = () => {
                        DOM.modalImg.src = img.src;
                        DOM.modal.style.display = 'flex';
                    };

                    const removeBtn = document.createElement('div');
                    removeBtn.className = 'chat-image-preview-remove';
                    removeBtn.textContent = 'â';
                    removeBtn.onclick = () => {
                        DOM.imagePreviewContainer.innerHTML = "";
                        ChatState.pendingImage = null;
                        DOM.imageInput.value = "";
                    };

                    wrapper.appendChild(img);
                    wrapper.appendChild(removeBtn);

                    DOM.imagePreviewContainer.innerHTML = "";
                    DOM.imagePreviewContainer.appendChild(wrapper);

                    ChatState.pendingImage = {
                        file,
                        previewUrl: reader.result
                    };
                };
                reader.readAsDataURL(file);
            },
        };

        const UploadHandlerQueue = [];

        const RatingHandler = {
            currentRating: -1,

            init() {
                DOM.stars.forEach((star, index) => {
                    star.addEventListener('mouseenter', () => this.highlight(index));
                    star.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => this.highlight(this.currentRating));
                    star.addEventListener('click', () => this.set(index));
                });
            },

            highlight(uptoIndex) {
                DOM.stars.forEach((star, i) => {
                    star.classList.toggle('selected', i <= uptoIndex);
                });
            },

            set(index) {
                this.currentRating = index;
                this.highlight(index);
                this.send(index + 1);
            },

            send(score) {
                Genesys("command", "Database.set", {
                    messaging: {
                        customAttributes: {
                            rating: score
                        }
                    }
                }, () => {
                    // 1. Hide original title and stars
                    const formTitle = DOM.postchatForm.querySelector('p');
                    const starsContainer = document.getElementById('postchat-stars');
                    const thankYouMsg = document.getElementById('postchat-thankyou');

                    if (formTitle) formTitle.style.display = 'none';
                    if (starsContainer) starsContainer.style.display = 'none';
                    if (thankYouMsg) thankYouMsg.style.display = 'block';

                    // 2. Wait and Close
                    setTimeout(() => {
                        closeChat();

                        // 3. Clear Data
                        ChatStorage.clear();
                        DOM.chatBody.innerHTML = '';
                        // Restore placeholder
                        const placeholder = document.createElement('div');
                        placeholder.id = 'chat-placeholder';
                        placeholder.className = 'chat-placeholder';
                        placeholder.innerHTML = 'Bu, bizimlÉ sÃ¶hbÉtinizin baÅlanÄÄ±cÄ±dÄ±r.<br />BaÅlamaq Ã¼Ã§Ã¼n mesaj gÃ¶ndÉrin.';
                        DOM.chatBody.appendChild(placeholder);
                        DOM.placeholder = placeholder;
                        ChatState.imageGallery = [];

                        // 4. Reset Post-Chat UI for next time
                        setTimeout(() => {
                            if (formTitle) formTitle.style.display = 'block';
                            if (starsContainer) starsContainer.style.display = 'flex';
                            if (thankYouMsg) thankYouMsg.style.display = 'none';
                            DOM.stars.forEach(s => s.classList.remove('selected'));
                            RatingHandler.currentRating = -1;
                        }, 500); // Wait for close animation

                    }, 2000);
                }, (err) => {
                    console.error("â Failed to send rating:", err);
                });
            }
        };

        const GenesysEvents = {
            subscribeToAll() {
                Genesys("subscribe", "Messenger.ready", () => {
                    DOM.chatBtn.style.display = 'block';
                });

                Genesys('subscribe', 'MessagingService.ready', () => {});

                Genesys("subscribe", "MessagingService.messagesReceived", e => {
                    const messages = e?.data?.messages || [];
                    messages.forEach(msg => {
                        if (msg && msg.type === "Event") {
                            const event = msg.events?.[0];
                            if (event?.presence?.type === "Disconnect") {
                                // showPostChatForm(); // Don't show post-chat form immediately on disconnect
                                addMessageToChat(TRANSLATION.chat_ended, "system");
                                return;
                            }
                        }

                        const type = msg.direction === "Inbound" ? "user" : "agent";
                        let text = msg?.text || msg?.message || "";
                        text = filterSystemMessage(text);
                        
                        if (text) {
                            DOM.placeholder.style.display = 'none';
                            DOM.typingIndicator.style.display = 'none';
                            addMessageToChat(`${text}<time>${getTime()}</time>`, type, true);
                        }

                        const contentArray = msg?.content || [];
                        contentArray.forEach(c => {
                            const attachment = c?.attachment;
                            if (attachment?.mime?.startsWith("image/") && attachment?.url) {
                                const imageHTML = `<img src="${attachment.url}" class="chat-image" /><time>${getTime()}</time>`;
                                addMessageToChat(imageHTML, type, true);
                            }
                        });
                    });
                });

                Genesys("subscribe", "Conversation.historyLoaded", e => {
                    const messages = e?.data?.messages || [];
                    messages.forEach(msg => {
                        const type = msg.direction === "Inbound" ? "user" : "agent";
                        let text = msg?.text || msg?.message || "";
                        text = filterSystemMessage(text);

                        if (text) addMessageToChat(`${text}<time>${getTime()}</time>`, type, true);
                    });
                });

                // Genesys("subscribe", "MessagingService.typingreceived", () => {
                //    DOM.typingIndicator.style.display = 'block';
                // });

                Genesys("subscribe", "MessagingService.typingtimeout", () => {
                    DOM.typingIndicator.style.display = 'none';
                });

                Genesys("subscribe", "MessagingService.fileUploaded", (event) => {
                    const handler = UploadHandlerQueue.shift();
                    if (handler && event?.data?.attachmentId) {
                        handler.resolve(event.data.attachmentId);
                    }
                });
            }
        };

        function getTime() {
            const now = new Date();
            return now.toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' });
        }

        function showError(inputId, message) {
            const input = document.getElementById(inputId);
            const errorSpan = document.getElementById('error-' + inputId.split('-')[1]);
            if (!input || !errorSpan) return;
            input.classList.add('input-error');
            errorSpan.innerText = message;
            errorSpan.style.display = 'block';
        }

        function clearErrors() {
            document.querySelectorAll('.input-error').forEach(el => el.classList.remove('input-error'));
            document.querySelectorAll('.error-message').forEach(el => {
                el.innerText = '';
                el.style.display = 'none';
            });
        }

        function addMessageToChat(content, type = "user", isHTML = false) {
            const msgDiv = document.createElement("div");
            msgDiv.className = `chat-message ${type}`;
            msgDiv.innerHTML = isHTML ? content : `${content}<time>${getTime()}</time>`;
            DOM.chatBody.appendChild(msgDiv);
            updateImageGallery();
            attachImageClickEvents();
            scrollToBottom();
            saveChatHistory();
        }

        function scrollToBottom() {
            DOM.chatBody.scrollTo({ top: DOM.chatBody.scrollHeight, behavior: 'smooth' });
        }

        function saveChatHistory() {
            ChatStorage.saveHistory(DOM.chatBody.innerHTML);
        }

        function restoreChatHistory() {
            const saved = ChatStorage.loadHistory()
            if (saved) {
                DOM.chatBody.innerHTML = saved;
                updateImageGallery();
                attachImageClickEvents();
            }
            DOM.typingIndicator.style.display = 'none';
        }

        function filterSystemMessage(text) {
            if (!text || typeof text !== 'string') return text;
            if (text.includes(" :: ")) {
                const parts = text.split(" :: ");
                const lang = 'az';
                let index = 0; // Default to AZ
                if (lang === 'ru') index = 1;
                if (lang === 'en') index = 2;
                
                return parts[index] || parts[0] || text;
            }
            return text;
        }

        function validatePrechatForm() {
            const nameInput = document.getElementById('prechat-name');
            const prefixSelect = document.getElementById('prechat-prefix');
            const phoneBodyInput = document.getElementById('prechat-phone-body');
            const termsCheckbox = document.getElementById('prechat-terms');

            clearErrors();
            let hasError = false;

            const name = nameInput.value.trim();
            const prefix = prefixSelect.value;
            const phoneBody = phoneBodyInput.value.replace(/\D/g, ''); // Strip non-digits
            const termsAccepted = termsCheckbox.checked;

            if (!name) {
                showError("prechat-name", TRANSLATION.val_name);
                hasError = true;
            }

            // Expecting exactly 7 digits
            if (phoneBody.length !== 7) {
                showError("prechat-phone", TRANSLATION.val_phone);
                hasError = true;
            }

            if (!termsAccepted) {
                showError("prechat-terms", TRANSLATION.val_terms);
                hasError = true;
            }

            return !hasError;
        }

       // Scroll Lock
        function addScrollLock() {
            const container = document.getElementById('chat-window');
            if(!container) return;

            container.addEventListener('wheel', function (e) {
                let target = e.target;
                let scrollable = null;

                // Find the nearest scrollable ancestor within the container
                while (target && target !== container) {
                    if (target.scrollHeight > target.clientHeight) {
                        const style = window.getComputedStyle(target);
                        if (['auto', 'scroll'].includes(style.overflowY)) {
                            scrollable = target;
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                    target = target.parentElement;
                }

                // If no scrollable area found, block scroll
                if (!scrollable) {
                    if (e.cancelable) e.preventDefault();
                    return;
                }

                // If scrollable, check edges
                const atTop = scrollable.scrollTop <= 0;
                const atBottom = Math.abs(scrollable.scrollHeight - scrollable.scrollTop - scrollable.clientHeight) < 1;

                if ((e.deltaY < 0 && atTop) || (e.deltaY > 0 && atBottom)) {
                    if (e.cancelable) e.preventDefault();
                }
            }, { passive: false });
        }


        function addListeners() {
            // Delete Listener
            if (DOM.deleteBtn) {
                 DOM.deleteBtn.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
                     e.stopPropagation();
                     DOM.deletePopup.style.display = 'flex';
                 });
            }

            if (DOM.deleteYesBtn) {
                DOM.deleteYesBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
                     ChatStorage.clear();
                     // Clear chat body and gallery
                     DOM.chatBody.innerHTML = ''; 
                     // Restore placeholder
                     const placeholder = document.createElement('div');
                     placeholder.id = 'chat-placeholder';
                     placeholder.className = 'chat-placeholder';
                     placeholder.className = 'chat-placeholder';
                     placeholder.innerHTML = TRANSLATION.welcome_message;
                     DOM.chatBody.appendChild(placeholder);
                     DOM.placeholder = placeholder; // Update ref

                     ChatState.imageGallery = [];
                     
                     // Send 'clear' command to Genesys if supported or just local clear
                     Genesys("command", "MessagingService.clearConversation");

                     DOM.deletePopup.style.display = 'none';
                     
                     // Smoothly close the chat
                     closeChat();
                });
            }

            if (DOM.deleteNoBtn) {
                 DOM.deleteNoBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
                     DOM.deletePopup.style.display = 'none';
                 });
            }


            DOM.prechatSubmit.onclick = async () => {
                if (!validatePrechatForm()) return;

                const name = document.getElementById('prechat-name').value.trim();
                const prefix = document.getElementById('prechat-prefix').value;
                const phoneBodyRaw = document.getElementById('prechat-phone-body').value.replace(/\D/g, '');
                
                // Combine prefix and body for CustomerID and Genesys
                const fullPhone = `994${prefix}${phoneBodyRaw}`;
                const clientData = { name, phone: fullPhone };

                await syncClientDataWithGenesys(clientData);
                showChatBody();
            };


            DOM.sendBtn.onclick = async () => {
                const text = DOM.input.value.trim();
                const pending = ChatState.pendingImage;

                if (!text && !pending) return;

                if (text) {
                    await new Promise(resolve => {
                        Genesys("command", "MessagingService.sendMessage", { message: text }, resolve, resolve);
                    });
                }

                if (pending?.file) {
                    disableSendButton();

                    const uploadId = await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
                        UploadHandlerQueue.push({ resolve, reject });

                        Genesys("command", "MessagingService.requestUpload", { file: [pending.file] },
                            () => {},
                            err => {
                                UploadHandlerQueue.pop();
                                reject(err);
                            }
                        );

                        setTimeout(() => {
                            const index = UploadHandlerQueue.findIndex(h => h.resolve === resolve);
                            if (index !== -1) {
                                UploadHandlerQueue.splice(index, 1);
                                reject("Upload timeout");
                            }
                        }, 15000);
                    });


                    await new Promise(resolve => {
                        Genesys("command", "MessagingService.sendMessage", {
                            uploads: [uploadId]
                        }, () => setTimeout(resolve, 300), () => setTimeout(resolve, 300));
                    });

                    enableSendButton();
                }

                DOM.input.value = "";
                if(DOM.placeholder) DOM.placeholder.style.display = 'none';
                DOM.imagePreviewContainer.innerHTML = "";
                ChatState.pendingImage = null;
                DOM.imageInput.value = "";
            };

            DOM.imageBtn.onclick = () => {
                DOM.imageInput.value = "";
                DOM.imageInput.click();
            };

            DOM.imageInput.addEventListener('change', async (event) => {
                const files = event.target.files;
                if (!files.length) return;

                const file = files[0];
                if (!file) return;

                await ImageHandler.handleUpload(file);
            });

            DOM.input.addEventListener("keydown", function (e) {
                if (e.key === "Enter" && !e.shiftKey) {
                    e.preventDefault();
                    DOM.sendBtn.click();
                }

                triggerTypingIndicator();
            });

            DOM.input.addEventListener('paste', () => {
                setTimeout(triggerTypingIndicator, 0);
            });

            // Phone Input Masking
            if (DOM.phoneInput) {
                DOM.phoneInput.addEventListener('input', function (e) {
                    let value = e.target.value.replace(/\D/g, '');
                    if (value.length > 7) value = value.substring(0, 7);

                    if (value.length > 5) {
                        value = value.substring(0, 3) + '-' + value.substring(3, 5) + '-' + value.substring(5);
                    } else if (value.length > 3) {
                        value = value.substring(0, 3) + '-' + value.substring(3);
                    }
                    e.target.value = value;
                });
            }

            DOM.closeBtn.onclick = closeChat;
            DOM.backBtn.onclick = closeChat;
        }

        function updateImageGallery() {
            ChatState.imageGallery = [...DOM.chatBody.querySelectorAll('.chat-image')].map(img => img.src);
        }

        function attachImageClickEvents() {
            DOM.chatBody.querySelectorAll('.chat-image').forEach((img, index) => {
                img.onclick = () => {
                    ChatState.currentImageIndex = index;
                    ModalHandler.showImage(index);
                };
            });
        }

        function disableSendButton() {
            DOM.sendBtn.classList.add('disabled', 'loading');
            DOM.sendBtn.disabled = true;
        }

        function enableSendButton() {
            DOM.sendBtn.classList.remove('disabled', 'loading');
            DOM.sendBtn.disabled = false;
        }

        function triggerTypingIndicator() {
            if (!DOM.chatWindow.classList.contains('state-chat')) return;
            if (typeof Genesys !== 'function') return;

            const now = Date.now();
            if (now - ChatState.lastTypingTime <= 2000) return;
            ChatState.lastTypingTime = now;

            Genesys("command", "MessagingService.sendTyping", {},
                () => {},
                (err) => console.error("â Typing indicator failed", err)
            );
        }

        function initConversation({ onPrechat, onPostchat, onChat, onError } = {}) {
            const parsed = ChatStorage.loadClientData();
            const hasClientData = !!(parsed?.name && parsed?.phone);
            const openKnownCustomerChat = () => {
                syncClientDataWithGenesys(parsed).finally(() => {
                    onChat?.();
                });
            }

            Genesys("command", "MessagingService.configureConversation", {}, (res) => {
                if (!hasClientData) {
                    onPrechat?.();
                } else {
                    openKnownCustomerChat();
                }
            }, (err) => {
                if (err === 'There is already an active conversation.' && hasClientData) {
                    openKnownCustomerChat();
                } else {
                    onError?.(err);
                    onPrechat?.();
                }
            });
        }

        function openChat() {
            initConversation({
                onPrechat: showPreChatForm,
                onPostchat: showPostChatForm,
                onChat: showChatBody
            });
        }

        function closeChat() {
            DOM.chatWindow.classList.remove('active');
            setTimeout(() => {
                DOM.chatBtn.style.display = 'flex';
            }, 300);
        }

        function showPreChatForm() {
            DOM.chatWindow.classList.add('active', 'state-prechat');
            DOM.chatWindow.classList.remove('state-chat', 'state-postchat');
            DOM.prechatForm.style.display = 'flex';
            DOM.chatBodyWrapper.style.display = 'none';
            DOM.postchatForm.style.display = 'none';
        }

        function showChatBody() {
            DOM.chatWindow.classList.add('active', 'state-chat');
            DOM.chatWindow.classList.remove('state-prechat', 'state-postchat');
            DOM.prechatForm.style.display = 'none';
            DOM.chatBodyWrapper.style.display = 'flex';
            DOM.postchatForm.style.display = 'none';
            ChatState.lastTypingTime = 0;

            requestAnimationFrame(() => scrollToBottom());
        }

        function showPostChatForm() {
            DOM.chatWindow.classList.add('active', 'state-postchat');
            DOM.chatWindow.classList.remove('state-prechat', 'state-chat');
            DOM.prechatForm.style.display = 'none';
            DOM.chatBodyWrapper.style.display = 'none';
            DOM.postchatForm.style.display = 'flex';

            ChatStorage.clear();
        }

        function init() {
            ModalHandler.init();
            RatingHandler.init();
            restoreChatHistory();
            addListeners();
            addScrollLock();
            GenesysEvents.subscribeToAll();
        }

        document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", init);
    </script>
</body>
</html>
